nodes.name: Environment & Infrastructure Setup
nodes.description: Virtual environment creation, requirements.txt, .env.example, .env, docker-compose.yml, Makefile, and initial project structure.
nodes.output: Active venv, installed packages (Django, DRF, simplejwt, Pillow, NumPy, pytest), .env, docker-compose.yml, Makefile
nodes.validation_criteria: Python packages importable without error; .env configuration readable.

nodes.name: Synthetic Dataset, Pretrained Model & Integrity Pack
nodes.description: Create Model/classifier.npz, Model/inference.py (predict function contract), Model/requirements.txt, Samples/images (60 images: 30 Normal, 30 Defective), Samples/labels.csv, Validation/ (3 fixtures: not_an_image.jpg, corrupt_image.png, too_small.png), and SHA256SUMS.txt.
nodes.output: Model/, Samples/, Validation/ directories with SHA256SUMS.txt matching hashes exactly.
nodes.validation_criteria: python Model/inference.py Samples/images/inspection_001.png prints valid JSON; SHA256 checksums match 100%.

nodes.name: Django Project Core Architecture
nodes.description: Initialize Django backend with config settings, urls, wsgi, custom apps registration, static/media configuration, REST Framework, CORS, and SimpleJWT.
nodes.validation_criteria: python manage.py check passes cleanly with no system check issues.

nodes.name: Accounts App & Role-Based Access Control
nodes.description: Custom User model with OPERATOR, SUPERVISOR, ADMIN roles; JWT auth endpoints (/api/auth/login/, refresh/, logout/, me/); DRF permissions (IsOperator, IsSupervisor, IsAdminUser); /api/users/ admin endpoints.
nodes.output: backend/apps/accounts/ models, views, serializers, permissions, urls
nodes.validation_criteria: Users created with roles; JWT login returns access/refresh and role; role permissions return 401 unauth and 403 forbidden.

nodes.name: Image Validator Service
nodes.description: backend/services/image_validator.py validating uploads before inference: extension/content type, real image check, corrupt/truncated image check with im.load(), dimension >= MIN_IMAGE_DIM (64), max size <= 10MB, returning standard error codes.
nodes.validation_criteria: Validation fixtures not_an_image.jpg, corrupt_image.png, too_small.png rejected with correct error codes.

nodes.name: Model Service & SHA256 Integrity Service
nodes.description: backend/services/model_service.py thin wrapper around Model.inference.predict; backend/services/integrity_service.py to verify filesystem files against SHA256SUMS.txt.
nodes.output: Model prediction dict (predicted_class, confidence, defect_probability, model_version); Integrity report dict.
nodes.validation_criteria: model_service output matches Model/inference.py output; integrity_service detects valid files and tampered copies.

nodes.name: Inspections App & API
nodes.description: Inspection model with immutability enforcement on completed inspections; POST /api/inspections/ (validate -> predict -> persist); GET /api/inspections/ (role-scoped); GET /api/inspections/{id}/.
nodes.validation_criteria: Upload valid plate persists prediction; upload invalid file rejects with 400 and creates no completed inspection; operator only sees own inspections; original prediction cannot be modified.

nodes.name: Reviews App & Append-Only History
nodes.description: Review model (inspection, reviewer, decision CONFIRMED/OVERRIDDEN, comment, timestamp); POST /api/inspections/{id}/reviews/ (supervisor/admin); GET reviews; immutability of reviews.
nodes.validation_criteria: Supervisor can create review; operator gets 403; multiple reviews append without altering inspection prediction; reviews cannot be updated or deleted.

nodes.name: Evaluation Metrics Service
nodes.description: backend/services/metrics_service.py loading Samples/labels.csv, running predict() without human reviews, computing TP, FN, FP, TN, 2x2 confusion matrix (rows=actual, cols=pred, order Normal, Defective), recall, accuracy, precision, failed predictions list, FN=0 caveat statement.
nodes.output: MetricsEvaluationResult dict with real calculated metrics
nodes.validation_criteria: Computed metrics match raw model outputs on all 60 sample images; FN=0 caveat triggered when applicable; missing files reported explicitly.

nodes.name: Evaluation App & Management Command
nodes.description: GET /api/evaluation/ (latest metrics), POST /api/evaluation/run/ (trigger fresh run, supervisor/admin); management command `run_evaluation`.
nodes.validation_criteria: python manage.py run_evaluation outputs full metrics; /api/evaluation/ returns verified metrics.

nodes.name: Model Integrity Admin API
nodes.description: GET /api/model/integrity/ (admin only) endpoint returning verified file statuses and mismatches against SHA256SUMS.txt.
nodes.output: Integrity status JSON with file-by-file verification
nodes.validation_criteria: Admin can query integrity; operator/supervisor receive 403; detects clean vs tampered state.

nodes.name: Seeding & Utility Scripts
nodes.description: scripts/create_admin.py, scripts/seed_users.py (creates operator1, supervisor1, admin1), scripts/run_evaluation.py.
nodes.output: Seeded database users with known passwords for testing/demo
nodes.validation_criteria: seed_users.py creates operator, supervisor, admin accounts; can log in immediately.

nodes.name: Frontend Industrial Dashboard UI
nodes.description: Bootstrap 5 + vanilla JS industrial dashboard: base.html (dark navy sidebar, light content, alerts), login.html, upload.html (drag & drop, spinner, validation errors, limits notice), inspection_detail.html (review timeline), history.html (table, filters, badges), review_queue.html, evaluation.html (2x2 confusion matrix, recall KPI, FN=0 notice), admin_dashboard.html (users, integrity).
nodes.output: Responsive web UI templates and JS controllers
nodes.validation_criteria: All pages render cleanly; user can log in, upload image, view result, review as supervisor, run evaluation, check integrity; no decorative non-working buttons.

nodes.name: Comprehensive Pytest Test Suite
nodes.description: pytest + pytest-django covering all 8 test areas in Section 10: validation rejection, prediction fields + model_version, inference parity, role permissions (401/403), append-only reviews, evaluation metrics & confusion matrix orientation, integrity check, end-to-end flow.
nodes.validation_criteria: 100% passing tests with 0 failures, testing real services without mocking the model.

nodes.name: System Verification, Demonstration & Documentation
nodes.description: Run smoke tests, Model/inference.py CLI test, evaluation command, UI walkthrough with screenshots proof, verify all Section 11 acceptance criteria, README.md setup documentation.
nodes.output: loop_log.md verified, screenshots captured, README.md complete
nodes.validation_criteria: All 7 acceptance criteria in Section 11 verified and demonstrated.
